title: @GROKSET: multi-party Human-LLM Interactions in Social Media

bias_targets.methodology: Dynamic analysis using an LLM-as-a-judge (Gemini) to evaluate conversational threads and detect language that signals normative labels, stereotyping, or loaded evaluative phrases that push a value judgment.
Automated safety analysis using the Detoxify library's multilingual models to screen the corpus and quantify identity attacks, along with other categories of toxic language, in the LLM's responses.
LLM-as-a-judge classification to detect instances where the assistant's language exhibits response bias or safety-alignment bias during controversial or highly polarized multi-party discussions.
